decision_anchor: T-59 entry-time snapshot; preserve saved 1 second order delay
entry_edge_definition: best executable-side expected net profit divided by that order's cash debit (gross notional plus cash fee); V1 share fees reduce net shares and therefore expected payout, not entry cash debit

sizing.percentage_base: free cash after locked positions and released settlements, before the new order

portfolio.minimum_order_source_status: current Gamma constraint; historical minimum is not archived
portfolio.depth_rule: full requested amount or no entry; do not shrink to available liquidity
portfolio.settlement_time: max(official Gamma resolved_at, market_start + 5 minutes) + 60 seconds

exit_family.liquidation_quote_rule: walk timestamped executable bid depth for the full open position; no forward fill; retry a triggered threshold only at a later causal decision quote

chronological_selection.selection_metric: maximum single-account cost-basis equity at the training cutoff, among configurations above the $100 no-trade control; if none exceed it, choose no trade
chronological_selection.tie_break: higher after-cost edge threshold, then lower per-order cap, then fewer trades
chronological_selection.portfolio_state: one continuous $100 path for every full-history comparison; no mid-run reset; training cutoff uses cash plus locked cost basis and does not recognize later outcomes

rebates.current_taker_rebate_terms: separate estimate only; historical thresholds and execution timing are unconfirmed

known_execution_limits: The T-59 ladder is the latest saved executable-side quote, not a guaranteed order-arrival fill after the saved one-second delay.
Historical fill acknowledgement and partial-fill records are absent; entry simulation remains full-request-or-skip.
Current minimum-size metadata is used because historical minimums are absent.
Taker fees are reconstructed from aggregate price levels; individual maker matches and exact per-match rounding are absent.
